## PRB1.3. Safety

-   In 2025, Bulatsa achieved the planned maturity levels set out in its performance plan for all five components of the EoSM. When looking ahead to end of RP4, Bulatsa has already achieved 4 out of 5 EoSM targets, needing improvement in Safety Risk Management component to reach the RP4 targets.

-   Bulgaria has not included any airports in their RP4 performance plans, thus not reporting on runway incursions during the reference period.

-   The rate of separation minima infringements (SMIs) at State level was 2.93, and at ANSP level 2.71. Both indicators were below the Union-wide average.
